title: Catch-Up Rate on Overdue Late Periods
content:
# Catch-Up Rate on Overdue Late Periods

Window Replacement Contracts — rate for late balance charges booked some time after a late period ended.

**Rule.** The catch-up share comes from the calendar days between the end of the first full period not yet charged and the day the charge is figured: more than 30 days (the stale-period day count) takes the stale-period share of 0.5; at least 15 days (the aging-period day count) and no more than 30 takes the aging-period share of 0.75; fewer than 15 days takes a share of one.

Full periods are runs of 30 calendar days counted from the late-charge start date. The first full period not yet charged ends 30 days after the end of the last period already carrying a late balance charge, or 30 days after the start date when none is charged; a full period counts as already charged when it ended on or before the date of the contract's latest late balance charge entry. The share multiplies the series monthly rate and the late-charge balance in the late-rate amount for one period, before that amount is rounded to the cent.

| Days from the end of the first uncharged full period to the day figured | Catch-up share |
|---|---|
| 0 to 14 | 1 |
| 15 to 30 | 0.75 |
| 31 or more | 0.5 |

## Boundaries (hypothetical: first uncharged period ended 2034-10-01)

| Day the charge is figured | Days after | Share |
|---|---|---|
| 2034-10-15 | 14 | 1 |
| 2034-10-16 | 15 | 0.75 |
| 2034-10-31 | 30 | 0.75 |
| 2034-11-01 | 31 | 0.5 |
